name: LXH254
sort_evidence: Novartis granted Erasca an exclusive worldwide licence to naporafenib (LXH254) in December 2022 and keeps a royalty, so the value to Novartis is a royalty stream rather than a programme it runs; Erasca's SEACRAFT-2 is the live Phase 3 (https://investors.erasca.com).

trials.title: Study of Efficacy and Safety of LXH254 Combinations in Patients With Previously Treated Unresectable or Metastatic Melanoma
